How to play Moon Rover: Anaxagoras

Each mission card lists a few objectives in the top-left. Mission 1 (Cold Start): press T to deploy the solar array, drive 120 m from the sled, then press G for a radar sweep. Later missions have you park on radar echoes, deploy the arm (R), aim it with W A S D and click to drill, carry samples back to the sled, lay relay beacons (B) to keep contact, and hold E at the old station to recover its logs. Watch power and hull: shadowed ground does not charge the array, and the sled recharges you and takes your samples. There is no score and no game over: if the hull gives out, the rover is winched back to the sled. Tab opens the field codex; Esc pauses.

Controls

Keyboard

W/S or ↑/↓ throttle and reverse · A/D or ←/→ steer · Space brake · mouse look (click the game to lock the pointer), wheel zoom · T solar array · G radar sweep · R arm (then W A S D aims, click drills) · B relay beacon · E hold to interact · F lamps · C camera · P photo mode (Q/Z up/down, Shift fast) · H hide HUD · Tab codex · Esc pause and release the pointer · X right the chassis after a rollover. K (save the frame as a PNG) does nothing inside our frame, because the frame blocks downloads.

Touch

Twin sticks: DRIVE (left) and LOOK (right). Buttons: CAM, LAMP, ARRAY, HUD, SHOT, BRAKE on the left; SCAN, ARM, DRILL, RELAY on the right. SHOT (save a screenshot) does nothing inside our frame. We have not tested the touch controls on a real phone.

Tips for Moon Rover: Anaxagoras

  • Deploy the solar array (T) first: it is the first objective and keeps your power up.
  • Park before drilling: deploying the arm (R) holds the chassis still while you aim.
  • Head back to the sled to recharge and unload samples. The Sample Bay holds 6.
  • Turn the lamps on (F) in shadowed craters, and check the field codex (Tab) after each discovery.
  • If it stutters, lower RENDER QUALITY under SYSTEMS on the main menu. It starts at a level guessed for your device.

FAQ

What is Moon Rover: Anaxagoras?

Our hosted, renamed copy of an open-source 3D lunar rover survey game by winch: it is based on REGOLITH (MIT) by winch. It is used under the MIT licence and credited on this page; it is not an official version and is not endorsed by the author.

Why is it called Moon Rover: Anaxagoras?

We renamed our copy so that we do not use the original game's name as our own; the MIT licence allows changes like this. The title, title screen and other text in the game now say Moon Rover: Anaxagoras, and the main menu and this page say it is based on REGOLITH (MIT) by winch. No game logic changed; one layout fix lets the menu scroll on phones.

Does it work on a phone?

It has twin-stick touch controls, but it is a heavy 3D game and we have not tested it on real phones, so we cannot say how well it runs there. It is best on a desktop or laptop with a keyboard.

What do I need to run it?

A browser with WebGL2. The game has no fallback: without WebGL2 it may not start at all.

Is my progress saved?

Yes. Progress and settings are kept in localStorage on the game's own web address (regolith.anaxagoras.v1 and regolith.anaxagoras.v1.set), in your browser only. There are no cookies and no account.

Can I lose?

No. There is no score and no game over. If the hull gives out, the rover is winched back to the sled and you carry on. Five missions lead to an ending.

Who made it and what is the licence?

winch made the original, released under the MIT licence (Copyright (c) 2026 winch). It runs on three.js r160, also MIT. The licence box on this page links the licence text at the exact source commit we use.

Our changes
No game logic changed. Renamed: the page title, the title screen and the other text players see now say Moon Rover: Anaxagoras instead of the original name, because we do not use the original name as our own (the MIT licence permits changes); the main menu credits it as based on REGOLITH (MIT) by winch, and the licence file is unchanged. The same change renamed the saved-picture file name, one sample label (now Mare Soil Core) and two loading and radar messages. The save keys (regolith.anaxagoras.v1 and regolith.anaxagoras.v1.set) are kept, so saved progress carries over. Removed the inline import map and rewrote the bare three.js imports to relative paths (import lines only), because our content security policy blocks inline scripts. Removed the data: favicon. Added the three.js r160 licence (MIT) and a PROVENANCE.txt. README, docs, server and package files not shipped. One layout fix lets the menu scroll on phones. The menu credit line is higher contrast, and the WebGL2 line no longer says the game is GPU accelerated. Full list: PROVENANCE.txt next to the game.
